candidate_relations.reason: The biopsy supports focal segmental necrotising immune-complex glomerulonephritis, while blood cultures and LVAD PET-CT findings identify chronic Corynebacterium jeikeium LVAD infection as the trigger; these required components are absent from the candidate.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures necrotising immune-complex glomerulonephritis with subendothelial deposits but omits the focal segmental pattern and infectious etiology.
